scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "GATEWAY,AUTH,PROFILE,APPT,CONSULT,RECORDS,NOTIF,HOSPITAL,SUPER,VIDEO" --prefix-colors "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgRed.bold,bgWhite.black.bold,bgGreen.black.bold,bgMagenta.black.bold,bgCyan.black.bold" "npm run start:dev --prefix api-gateway" "npm run start:dev --prefix services/auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/profile-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/appointment-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/consultation-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/medical-records-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/notification-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/hospital-admin-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/super-admin-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/video-chat-service"
scripts.install:all: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), cp = require('child_process'), path = require('path'); const dirs = ['api-gateway', ...fs.readdirSync('services').map(s => path.join('services', s)).filter(d => fs.existsSync(path.join(d, 'package.json')))]; dirs.forEach(d => { console.log('Installing in ' + d + '...'); cp.execSync('npm install', { cwd: d, stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); });"
scripts.seed:all: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), cp = require('child_process'); const seeds = [{ dir: 'services/auth-service', cmd: 'npm run db:seed' }, { dir: 'services/profile-service', cmd: 'npx prisma db seed' }, { dir: 'services/appointment-service', cmd: 'npm run seed' }, { dir: 'services/consultation-service', cmd: 'npm run seed' }, { dir: 'services/medical-records-service', cmd: 'npm run seed' }, { dir: 'services/hospital-admin-service', cmd: 'npm run db:seed' }]; seeds.forEach(s => { console.log('Seeding ' + s.dir + '...'); try { cp.execSync(s.cmd, { cwd: s.dir, stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); } catch (e) { console.error('Failed seeding ' + s.dir, e.message); } });"
